name: trading-skills
description: Personal mirror of tradermonty/claude-trading-skills, packaged as an installable plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: claude-trading-skills
plugins.description: 72 trading skills: market regime detection, VCP/CANSLIM/dividend screeners, position sizing, backtesting, trade journaling and postmortems. Most screeners require an FMP API key; market-breadth-analyzer and uptrend-analyzer work with no key.
